purpose: Extend and verify official/institutional secondary research for Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru without converting innovation-system context, project activity, funding supply or benchmark indicators into AI4WORK need-prevalence claims.

promoted_source.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Research and Innovation / Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs
promoted_source.title: Regional Innovation Scoreboard 2025 — Regional profile Romania
promoted_source.source_interpretation: The source provides a single official, methodologically comparable NUTS2 innovation/digital-capacity frame across all three AI4WORK target regions. It supports regional heterogeneity and weak innovation/digital-system context, not the prevalence, cause or ranking of AI4WORK skill needs.
limitations: RIS indicator values recorded above are performance benchmarks relative to the EU reference, not raw population or enterprise prevalence percentages.
Cloud-computing, ICT-specialist and lifelong-learning indicators are contextual innovation-system indicators; they do not measure AI4WORK adult competence or employer training demand.
Regional Innovation Index performance cannot be converted into a percentage of people or employers needing training.
No S41 value is promoted to H1-H5 or used to alter the deterministic need ranking before sufficient real primary evidence exists.

call_requirements_refresh.gmail_query_scope: after:2026/09/02 excluding spam/trash/GitHub; terms 367944, AI4WORK, OMIPE, MIPE, PEO, 1302, Anexa 4, eucons.ro, Claus, GDPR

refresh_conclusion: S41 materially improves official cross-region comparative context because the same European Commission RIS 2025 framework directly covers Centru, Sud-Muntenia and Sud-Vest Oltenia. It remains secondary context only and adds zero H1-H5. Fresh connected Drive searches still surface control/SSOT/pre-final materials rather than an eligible immutable real adult+employer response export, and no new authority/provider email changes Call Requirements.
